name: PER_ASG_REPRESENTATIVES
description: This is a de-normalized table which will hold mapping between worker & its representatives which are active and effective as of today.

columns.name: RESPONSIBILITY_ID
columns.description: The foreign key for areas of responsibility record.

columns.name: RESPONSIBILITY_TYPE
columns.description: The responsibility type for which this record is holding the criteria.

columns.name: REPRESENTATIVE_PERSON_ID
columns.description: The person id of worker representative.

columns.name: REPRESENTATIVE_ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: The assignment id of worker representative

columns.name: WORK_CONTACTS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to include this row in work contacts evaluation

columns.name: APPROVALS_FLAG
columns.description: Responsibility will be included with Approvals processing.

columns.name: CHECKLISTS_FLAG
columns.description: Responsibility will be included with Checklist processing.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
